items.content:
THANKS TO TRUMP, THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ REMAINS CLOSED FOR ALL PRACTICAL PURPOSES.
 x.com/kpler/status/208678476… Kpler (@Kpler)Weekend traffic diverges at chokepoints

Traffic through the Strait of Hormuz remained subdued over the past week and weakened further into the weekend. From 7 to 9 August, confirmed crossings fell from 15 on Friday to 11 on Saturday and just six on Sunday, bringing the three day total to 32. Routing also remained concentrated, with 17 vessels using the Iranian Unilateral Scheme and 10 classified as Route Undetermined.

Bab el-Mandeb remained considerably more active, recording 116 crossings over the same period. Daily traffic stayed comparatively stable at 43, 37 and 36 crossings, although 12 dark transits and elevated sanctioned activity continued to highlight visibility and risk concerns.
